The main takeaway from our work is that

the strategic use of rights discourse is not only a useful tool for actors involved in the ratification of free trade agreements but also an important tool for understanding the political economy of the negotiation of free trade agreements and other international trade agreements in general.

the use of rights based arguments in the negotiation and approval process of FTAs is an important tool for actors to build political coalitions and shape the political discourse in a way that is beneficial to their own interests.
the use of rights based arguments is not necessarily a sign of a rights based politics.
